changes: Protected document previews use the current sign-in, retry expired authentication once, and show clear retry, permission and missing-original messages.
Passports, card scans and other PDFs render inside Teluva, including protected files whose URL has no extension. Switching documents resets page navigation.
Life Atlas globe dragging works with mouse and touch, including browsers without SVG pointer capture. Valid GPS pins, including zero coordinates, stay visible.
Atlas distinguishes unchecked, unreadable and missing photo GPS. Read details from an original photo to review its location without replacing the cover or overwriting the recorded story date.
